title: Handoff
description: The envelope passed between stages. A stage may only advance when green is true; otherwise it routes or escalates.

green.description: true ONLY when this stage's gate actually passed and was verified (tests green / CRAP <= 6 / survivors == 0). Never assert green you did not run.

gate_evidence.description: the verified facts behind green; shape depends on stage

next.description: where this goes next: a single forward stage, 'done', or a list of routed remediation targets

human_gate.description: set on the stage that precedes a human gate. gate 'plan' = the consolidated PLAN review, DEEP, after stages 0+1 run silently — covers task graph (breadth) + maximal behavior decomposition (depth) + pruned Gherkin + prune_log in one verdict, before any code. gate '2' = code spot-check, LIGHT, after architect. only the specifier sets gate 'plan' (it produces the last plan artifact); the hardener hands off straight to the specifier with no gate.

routes.description: per-item remediation routing (survivor -> owning stage+task); used instead of a global reset

ref.description: scenario_id / line / function the survivor points at
